gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Noto Sans Sinhala lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase along every line, its curve endings staying well apart. Groovy, nearly closed and funky, gives that openness something to push against.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Noto Sans Soyombo is sans-serif, its curves wide-mouthed and unclosed, its x-height sizable. But Groovy, with its loosely tracked lowercase and a c nearly shut to a slit, goes friendly and funky.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Groovy looks drawn with a single nib, loosely tracked and friendly. Noto Sans Sundanese is the low-key partner, with open-mouthed e crossbars and caps sitting almost level with its lowercase.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Chunky outlines, loose tracking, a friendly wink up top. Groovy is best at making a bold one-weight statement, while Noto Sans Sunuwar does its best work with open curves and short ascender stems.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-syloti-na: Friendly, funky Groovy narrows its c to a slit and spaces its lowercase loosely. Noto Sans Syloti Nagri takes the quieter job, with short ascenders and a lower bowl on the a that stays open.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Funky slits up top, glass-bulb curves underneath. Groovy's n keeps arch and stem matching, while Noto Sans Syriac, a plain sans, swells its bowls and eases its s turns wide.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-syriac-ea: Approachable Noto Sans Syriac Eastern sits under funky, friendly Groovy. Its tall lowercase stands against small caps, and curve endings that never crowd each other keep long paragraphs moving.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-syriac-we: Funky Groovy bends its s curves like wire, never thinning at the spine. Noto Sans Syriac Western, a plain sans, keeps terminals far from the stroke while small letters stack up dense and tall.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Friendly funk up top: Groovy holds its arms and legs to constant width. And Noto Sans Tagalog, a plain sans, lets generous curve gaps and a dominant middle zone carry paragraph after paragraph smoothly.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Noto Sans Tagbanwa is a sans with open curves, clear gaps, and lowercase filling most of the height. Groovy has no thick-thin pulse to carry the eye, so the body does the carrying when text runs on.
